MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The single pack of VELCRO felt like a plausible next choice because it could help with light mounting, which connects to my recent drywall anchors and screws.",
    "A manageable amount made that VELCRO worth trying for a small mounting task without committing to a large supply."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Thermometers and a precision caliper serve needs I have not shown; buying fasteners does not mean I currently need temperature checks or precision measuring tools.",
    "Locking nuts and metal-cutting wheels do not follow directly from wood screws and framing nails, especially without matching bolts or a compatible cutting tool.",
    "The bulk glue and duct tape felt excessive without a specific repair, while waterproof putty and brick-or-concrete mounting tape assumed tasks I have not indicated."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations treated a broad connection to tools and repairs as enough, even when the actual job differed from fastening and mounting.",
    "My purchases of large packs of fasteners seemed to translate into bulk repair supplies, although needing many screws does not mean I need many tubes of glue or rolls of tape."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The intended material and fastening method matter to me: wood screws, framing nails, and drywall anchors do not establish a need for metal cutting, bolt hardware, or masonry mounting.",
    "I need a clear current use and a suitable quantity before choosing something; general usefulness alone is not enough.",
    "My vacuum bags and medicine cups also reflect specific household supply needs, so my recent activity should not all be read as one broad repair project."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my mounting interests but stretched them into unrelated tools and repair supplies without enough evidence of a current need."
}
